style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
subject: aardwolf, striped hyena build, raised mane, tan fur; same animal every beat
second_characters: termites in neckties like office clerks, at the lens

props.can: an empty battered tin can in one paw, bottom to the lens

environment: midday savanna, red clay mounds, dry grass, dust
lighting: white daylight, hard sun left, warm clay bounce right
motion_rule: lateral tracking: camera rides alongside the hero and never stops, mounds tear past, hero reverses at 2.10, 4.80, 7.30; new shot size every beat; one hero action per beat; hero throws his body across the full width of frame every beat, filling half the frame height, muzzle to the lens, medium to close

audio.rate: 3.8 syllables per second; each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0; speech ends by 7.30; then wind and insect rattle
audio.lip_sync: muzzle to the lens, jaw opens every syllable, mouth empty while speaking; termites enter only as he snaps them
audio.pronunciation: ter-MI-tov, NOCH-yu, pro-kor-MIT, ot-DAT, E-ta, mo-YO

timeline.a: bursts in from the left, tearing across the frame side-on, belly flat; two necktied termites tumble off a mound at the lens
on the move thrusts the empty can at the lens bottom first, shakes it - nothing falls; one termite dangles from the rim
wheels around mid-stride, right to left, mane whipping; a column of necktied termites marches across the foreground at him
strides across frame snapping termites off the clay wall, jaw clacking each syllable; termites swarm the can he holds at the lens
bangs the can on a mound while moving, bottom to the lens, belly rounder; one termite spills out and crawls off the low edge
picks up pace, sweeping the can along the lens bottom first; three termites chase it, neckties flying
skids sideways past the lens, flips the can over, belly swinging him over; two termites rear up at the lens
plows across frame, belly dragging through dust; a layer of necktied termites parts ahead of him
mashes the can into clay with one paw while moving, eyes cutting to the lens; one termite climbs it and spreads its legs
brakes sideways, drops the can - it lands upright and empty, belly sagging to the ground; termites stream around it both sides
belly bloats from inside and yanks him sideways, paws scraping dust, torn off the spot; A SWARM presses out from under it
slides sideways riding his own belly, legs splayed, paws dragging, dust plume from under it, muzzle to the lens, blank stare past it; termites pour from under him
slides out past the right edge, limp paw last; empty frame - the can stands upright, one termite crawls down it

must_appear: upended empty can, bottom to the lens, at 0.70, 2.10, 3.95; belly flat at 0.00, round at 3.95, sagging at 7.30; necktied termites at the lens every beat; at 8.50 legs splayed, paws limp, dust plume under belly; at 9.25 empty frame, can upright, one termite crawls down it
negative_prompt: tongue out while speaking, snarl at camera, hero lifted off the ground, conveyor belt, night, dark scene, moonlight, subtitles, watermark, printed words, digits, Cyrillic or Latin, speech bubble, horizontal frame, black bars, speech after 7.30, English speech, foreign accent, extra limbs, a second hyena, wide shot, hero standing still, vertical jumping, view from behind, parked camera, push in, motionless background, duplicate props
